title: chore: update app metrics 2026-09-30
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Daily automated update of app request and repository metrics

gist.headline: The garden gets counted
gist.blurb: The daily app metrics are in. Even digital gardens need someone to count the sprouts.
gist.summary: The automated September 30 update refreshed app request and repository metrics in operations/app-management/app.json.
gist.impact: Maintainers have current request and repository figures for tracking apps; this does not change the user experience.
gist.visual_concept: Depict internal app tracking as a cozy garden ledger: Polli checks a clipboard beside small code-plants and a retro monitor showing simple charts. There is no app-specific mascot in this update.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, Polli checks a tiny clipboard beside code-plants and a retro monitor with simple charts glowing lime green (#ecf874). The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny reading glasses and shares the frame with the garden. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites, and a warm cream background.
